page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7t.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. This instance features 2 physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing 2 dedicated vCPUs. It is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The processor includes 48 KB of L1d cache, 1 MB of L2 cache, and 48 MB of L3 cache, alongside support for advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and cryptography acceleration via AES and SHA_NI. This instance does not include local storage or GPU hardware, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps under a KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance asymmetry between single-core and multi-core operations. The instance achieves average performance in single-core metrics, with a Geekbench single-core score of 1580.0 and a stress-ng single-core CPU score of 1873.79. However, multi-core and memory bandwidth benchmarks fall into the lower percentiles. The stress-ng multi-core performance is rated poor at 1935.57, and the Geekbench multi-core score is 1823.0. Memory bandwidth is also constrained, with large-block read and write speeds measuring 13.97 GB/sec and 12.92 GB/sec respectively, both of which rank in the bottom 10% of tested systems.

Given its high memory allocation relative to compute resources, the ecs.r7t.large is structured for memory-intensive workloads that do not require heavy parallel processing. It is suitable for small-scale caching layers, lightweight database operations, and text processing tasks, where its average single-core performance can be leveraged. However, it is poorly suited for multi-threaded compilation, ray tracing, or high-throughput database operations due to its low multi-core and memory bandwidth scores. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, this instance offers a low-cost entry point to dedicated Intel Xeon resources with a high memory-to-core ratio, though users trade off multi-threaded performance and local storage.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7t.large is an x86_64 memory-optimized instance featuring 2 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor at 2.7 GHz, paired with 16.0 GB of RAM. It lacks local storage and GPU accelerators, relying on a 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Performance benchmarks reveal a significant contrast: single-core metrics, such as Geekbench single-core (1580.0) and single-threaded gzip compression (28.12 GB/sec), rank in the average tier, whereas multi-core and memory bandwidth metrics fall into the bottom 10%. With a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU, this instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-dependent, low-compute workloads. It is best suited for lightweight caching, text processing, and basic web serving, but exhibits clear performance limitations for multi-threaded compilation, intensive database operations, or high-throughput parallel processing.
